mapper.sql: id , create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, type_id, user_post_id
mapper.select: SELECT ko.kingdee_id AS syncKingdeeId, krp.code AS code, krp.kingdee_department_id AS kingdeeDepartmentId, kd.kingdee_dept_name AS kingdeeDepartmentName, kd.erp_dept_id AS departmentId, sd.name AS departmentName, su.user_name AS userName, su.real_name AS realName, su.mobile AS mobile, su.user_state AS userState, su.delete_state AS deleteState, su.user_state AS userState, krp.erp_user_id AS userId FROM kingdee_operator_ref_post ko LEFT JOIN kingdee_user_ref_post krp ON krp.id = ko.user_post_id AND krp.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN kingdee_department kd ON kd.id = krp.kingdee_department_id AND kd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN sys_user_info su ON su.uid = krp.erp_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_department sd ON sd.id = kd.erp_dept_id WHERE ko.is_deleted = FALSE AND krp.erp_user_id is not null AND kd.erp_dept_id is not null AND ko.type_code = #{params.type} AND ko.use_org_id = #{params.orgId} and ko.disabled = false
